company.name: GODHANDS
company.shortDescription: GodHands develops a deterministic automation API and infrastructure for AI agents to control desktop and web applications.
company.description: GodHands develops developer tools and infrastructure that provide deterministic action and computer use frameworks for AI agents. The company focuses on overcoming the fragility of standard UI automation when agents interact with modern web, legacy desktop, and non-API software environments. GodHands offers a unified automation API for desktop operating systems and web systems so agents can execute tasks with consistent, human-like interaction patterns. Its technology is intended for builders of enterprise and B2B software agents that must operate reliably across tools such as spreadsheets, email clients, CRM platforms, and other business applications. By abstracting away per-application integrations, GodHands enables engineering teams to design robust automated workflows that remain stable even as visual interfaces and deep workflows change over time.

productsAndServices.description: GodHands Automation API provides a deterministic computer use and system-wide automation layer that lets AI agents operate desktop and web applications.
